answer: A workable defense is requiring each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade. Creating one identity is cheap, but creating thousands means locking capital for every copy, so a sybil attacker must fund each fake separately and loses the stake if peers catch it cheating. Reputation then builds slowly, like coral growing on a reef, while a new account starts on the lowest terrace of trust with small transaction limits until it proves honest behavior over time.
